question_intents: How to manage and trigger production Kanbans
data.summary: The Kanbans menu provides a centralized interface for managing production Kanbans through dedicated tabs for filtering, viewing current status, and triggering execution. It includes specific controls for selecting Kanbans via groups or hashtags, monitoring running processes, and modifying their status or details.

own_body.title: Kanbans
own_body.summary: The Kanbans menu is a tab where users can find and trigger production Kanbans, featuring three main buttons: Filter, Current, and Trigger.
question_intents: What buttons are in the Kanbans menu?

children.title: Groups
children.summary: The section explains the Filter, Current, Trigger, and Groups tabs in their corresponding sections.

children.title: Filter tab
children.summary: The section describes a filter tab that opens a scrollable menu to select and filter created Kanbans within the current system configuration, noting that all Kanbans are visible by default.

children.title: Current tab
children.summary: The 'Current tab' interface displays currently running Kanbans and provides controls for managing them. Users can click the eye icon to view detailed step information or the cog icon to access settings for modifying status, removing, or advancing the Kanban.
question_intents: How to view or edit Kanban details

children.title: Trigger tab
children.summary: The Trigger tab displays a scrollable list of Kanbans available for triggering within the current configuration. It supports filtering through pre-configured groups and hashtags, allowing users to select specific Kanbans for execution via the Trigger menu.
question_intents: How to use the Trigger tab
